items.title: Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft Has Flown
items.originalTitle: Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft Has Flown
items.summary: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today. Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time. Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.

evidenceRecords.text: We have a significant update on the fast-moving world of Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) out of Mojave, California today.
Northrop Grumman’s Talon Blue, which now has the official designation YFQ-48A, has taken to the skies for the first time.

Talon Blue flying out of Mojave Air and Space Port for the first time. (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 The uncrewed aircraft took to the skies over Mojave Air and Space Port, home of famed ‘bleeding0edge’ airframer and Northrop Grumman subsidiary Scaled Composites, which built the aircraft.
3, 2026 – Northrop Grumman’s (NYSE: NOC) YFQ-48A Talon Blue completed its first fully autonomous flight, including taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers, and landing.
The flight builds on Northrop Grumman’s seven decades of autonomy experience and more than 500,000 autonomous flight hours, with lessons from Talon Blue informing future autonomous systems.

Details on YFQ-48A Talon Blue: Talon Blue is part of Northrop Grumman’s internally-funded Project Talon portfolio focused on accelerating the development of mission-ready autonomous airpower capabilities.

Every flight and lesson strengthens our broader autonomy work and sharpens what comes next.” Talon Blue flying above the Mojave Desert in California. (Northrop Grumman) While the Talon Blue aircraft draws most of the attention, Northrop Grumman has put great emphasis on its back-end autonomy development ecosystem, which includes its purpose-built Model 437 demonstrator aircraft , now under the Talon IQ badge (formerly Beacon).

Talon Blue is entering a growing field of CCA offerings, with extremely intense competition, that are primarily aimed at equipping the USAF with its next CCA acquisition of hundreds of aircraft known as Increment 2 , for which the requirements remain undefined.

Many more types are on the horizon, including those from new players and globally from foreign manufacturers . (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 (@Task_Force23) TASK_FORCE23 With the loss of the F/A-XX next-generation naval fighter program to Boeing, Northrop Grumman winning a contract from the U.S. services for Talon Blue has become more important.

“SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper.
SM-6 is the only combat-proven weapon that can perform anti-air warfare, anti-surface warfare and ballistic missile defense.

“SM-6’s multi-mission capability is vital to our customer, and Raytheon is intensely focused on meeting the demand,” said Raytheon President Phil Jasper. “By continuously investing in our operations and facilities, we are removing constraints and boosting capacity to ensure we deliver this critical capability our sailors depend on.”
It has been successfully fired from various U.S.
Navy ship-based platforms and launchers on land, providing the fleet with a versatile and highly reliable weapon to counter the full range of kinetic threats faced by today’s naval forces.

items.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
items.originalTitle: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
items.summary: In an essay published in The Atlantic, Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches. He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.” But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies.

evidenceRecords.text: In an essay published in The Atlantic, Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches.
He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.”
But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies.

And while much of the reporting around OpenAI has focused on how the company’s CEO Sam Altman lost the trust of former colleagues, Robinson’s essay suggests that OpenAI’s culture issues are the same as those of Silicon Valley at large.
In response to Robinson’s essay, OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the company continues to improve its safety measures.

“Perhaps I should have stayed and fought for fundamental shifts in our staffing and culture, but in practice, my colleagues and I were so busy sprinting that we seldom had the chance to consider big changes, much less to actually make them,” Robinson said. “That’s why I concluded that stronger incentives for safety — coming from outside the company — are a big part of getting this right.”

He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.” But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies.

items.summary: Yuval Boger interviews Helmut Katzgraber, general partner at 55North and former quantum leader at AWS. events.title: 以色列对加沙袭击致七人死亡，“停火”违规持续
events.summary: 在以色列继续违反已持续近一年的“停火”之际，加沙地带至少七名巴勒斯坦人在以色列袭击中丧生，十多人受伤。半岛电视台记者欣德·胡达里从加沙城报道称，医生表示由于多年以色列袭击和封锁使医疗系统遭到摧毁，挽救伤者生命十分困难。她还表示，此次袭击的死亡人数未来数小时可能上升。胡达里说，加沙本应实现停火，但以色列军队的暴力没有尽头，巴勒斯坦人每天都在被杀、受伤，人道局势不断恶化，加沙居民的生存条件“可怕”。

events.title: 巨大飞跃：研究人员在轨演示可编程量子光子处理器
events.summary: 研究人员在轨运行了一台可编程量子光子处理器，演示了双光子干涉，作为迈向星载量子计算的早期一步。该处理器在六路径光路中操纵两个光子，但探测器故障、辐射损伤和阳光相关噪声限制了其性能。研究人员已在轨运行一台可编程量子光子处理器，展示了一种基于光的计算能力，最终可能帮助卫星在将数据传回地球之前进行分析。

events.summary: 据地区与西方国家官员向路透社透露，沙特阿拉伯正计划对也门境内由伊朗支持的胡塞武装发动攻势，目前正在考虑多种方案。选项包括沿红海海岸推进以保障红海航运路线，或在多条战线同时发起进攻。报道未说明行动的具体时间表或最终是否实施。
